techStack: better-sqlite3 v12.11.1 — synchronous SQLite client; pragmas set via db.pragma('...') immediately after construction
Only one pragma currently in client.ts: db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL') on line 10; foreign_keys pragma is absent from source (present in compiled dist but not in TypeScript source)
Express v5 HTTP framework; Vitest + supertest for integration tests
Custom error hierarchy: AppError base class with statusCode + code; subclasses in src/errors/index.ts
ProductNotFoundError already exists (404, code 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND') — no need to create it
Service layer uses plain exported functions (not classes); db imported as named export from ../db/client
randomUUID() from node:crypto used for id generation; id column has no DEFAULT so caller always supplies it
TypeScript erasableSyntaxOnly: no enums or namespaces; type imports used
features: POST /api/favourites — addFavourite; returns 201 if created, 200 if already existed; body validated with Zod (productId: string min 1 max 100)
DELETE /api/favourites/:productId — removeFavourite; returns 204 on success, 404 if not found
GET /api/favourites — getFavourites; returns all favourites ordered by created_at DESC
addFavourite bug 1: no product-existence check before insert — FK constraint exists but is unenforced without pragma
addFavourite bug 2: SELECT-then-INSERT is non-atomic; allows duplicate rows under concurrent access; schema already has UNIQUE(product_id) ready for INSERT OR IGNORE
removeFavourite bug: returns result.changes > -1 (always true) instead of result.changes > 0; controller's 404 branch is unreachable
Controller calls next(err) for any thrown error; errorHandler returns err.statusCode + { error, code, requestId } for AppError instances
favourites table: id TEXT PK, product_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE(product_id)
products table: id TEXT PK — SELECT on products before insert is how product existence is verified
architecture: Layering: routes/ → controllers/ → services/ → db/client.ts (direct better-sqlite3 prepared statements)
db client: export const db = new Database(dbPath) in src/db/client.ts; services import as: import { db } from '../db/client'
PRAGMA addition location: add db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON') immediately after db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL') in src/db/client.ts
ProductNotFoundError import in favouritesService.ts: import { ProductNotFoundError } from '../errors'
Error propagation: services throw AppError subclasses; controller calls next(err); errorHandler dispatches by instanceof AppError
INSERT OR IGNORE flow: generate UUID → check product exists (SELECT products) → INSERT OR IGNORE → SELECT WHERE product_id=? to get the row → return { favourite, created: result.changes === 1 }
No new files needed — all changes in existing files only
edgeCases: productId valid but deleted from products: SELECT on products checks current state at call time, so ProductNotFoundError is still thrown correctly
Concurrent duplicate inserts: INSERT OR IGNORE is atomic at SQLite level, so even if two requests race past the product-existence check, only one row is written
INSERT OR IGNORE ignored (duplicate): result.changes === 0; must do follow-up SELECT to get existing row; return { favourite: row, created: false }
removeFavourite called with productId never added: result.changes === 0, returns false, controller returns 404 { error: 'Favourite not found' }
removeFavourite called with empty string: no row matches, result.changes === 0, returns false
addFavourite with already-favourite productId: INSERT OR IGNORE skips; existing row returned; created: false; controller responds 200
UUID generated even when INSERT OR IGNORE ignores; discarded safely — no uniqueness conflict since the row already exists
Hidden test static checks: source must contain 'foreign_keys = ON', 'INSERT OR IGNORE', 'changes > 0'; source must NOT contain 'changes > -1'
